app.uploadHint: Drop a photo or PDF (e-Tax Invoice) here or pick one. On a phone you can take it right away.
app.noAi: AI reading isn't available here. Open this page while signed in to claude.ai.
app.noImage: This view can't send photos to the AI.
app.aiFail: Couldn't read the document. The photo may be blurry or cut off. Retake it in good light with the whole page visible.
app.notDoc: This doesn't look like a receipt or tax invoice. Try another photo.
app.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
app.badImage: This file format can't be read. Use a JPG/PNG photo or a PDF.
app.saveFail: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
app.notGranted: You don't have permission to save. Ask the page owner for access.
app.photoNotSaved: No permission to store photos, so only the details were saved.

checks.items: Lines: qty × price = amount, sum matches
checks.claimWindow: Input VAT claim window (6 months after the invoice month)

detail.noCompany: Add our company tax ID in settings below to compare
detail.differ: Differs from our company · VAT may not be claimable
detail.checkPhoto: Compare the dotted fields with the photo
detail.dupFound: Same seller and document number already in the ledger

photo.noBox: No position data for this field. Zoom into the photo to check it.

review.invalid: Some fields have the wrong format. Check the red fields.

settings.title: Settings
settings.formDesc: Change the block order, visible fields and field names of the organized form. Applies to the whole company.
settings.blocksHint: Use the arrows to reorder and the switches to hide blocks. Seller, customer, items and totals always stay.
settings.fieldsHint: Turning a field off hides it in view mode only. Edit mode still shows every field.
settings.labelsHint: Fill in only the languages you want to change. Empty means the default name.
settings.resetDone: Reset to defaults. Press Save to apply.

ui.reviewHint: Compare with the original and review the fields that need attention.
ui.originalHint: Zoom or rotate to inspect. Select a review badge to jump to its location.
ui.checksHint: Start with the items that need attention.
ui.workspaceIntro: Review the original beside its organized form, and check amounts and document details.
ui.sampleIntro: Explore a trilingual form, photo zoom, and automatic checks with the PANFOOD sample.
ui.settingsIntro: Arrange blocks, choose visible fields, and rename labels with a live preview.
ui.previewNotice: Sample review and form settings are available now. Photo upload, ledger storage, and sign-in are still in development.

batch.title: Read documents from photos
batch.intro: Upload up to {max} tax invoices or receipts and the AI reads them {at} at a time. Quick shoot can even take two per shot.
batch.formats: JPG · PNG · HEIC (iPhone) · PDF · one document per photo (two in Quick shoot)
batch.limit: You can upload up to {max} photos at once. {count} were left out.
batch.full: All {max} photos are in. Remove one to add another.
batch.noKey: No AI key yet. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local and restart the server.
batch.network: The connection dropped. Check your internet and tap Read again.
batch.busy: The AI is busy right now. Wait a moment and tap Read again.
batch.checkHint: The AI may misread it. Retake it, or read it as it is.

issue.duplicate: Looks like a photo already uploaded

batch.dropPhone: Pick or take photos of documents
batch.dupLedger: Same photo as a document in the ledger ({no}). Stopped before the AI read it (no cost).
batch.dupDraft: Same photo as a draft ({no}). Stopped before the AI read it (no cost).
batch.dupQueue: The same photo is already in this list. Stopped before the AI read it (no cost).

del.title: Delete this document?
del.desc: It disappears from the ledger right away and is kept in the trash. Admins can restore it any time.
del.reasonPh: Say why it is being deleted
del.shredding: Moving the document to the trash…
del.done: Moved to the trash. Admins can restore it.
del.sampleDone: This is the sample, so it was not actually deleted.

trash.empty: No documents in the ledger yet. Upload a photo to start.
trash.notFound: Document not found. It may have been deleted.
trash.inTrash: This document is in the trash
trash.adminOnlyTrash: Only admins can see the trash.

archive.drafted: Saved as a draft. Continue from Ledger › Drafts.
archive.draftNote: Drafts are not in the monthly totals. Open one and tap ‘Save to ledger’ to move it into the ledger.
archive.stickerHint: Sort documents with colour stickers. A document can have several, and you can rename them for your company.
archive.search: Search by seller, document no. or amount

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter the email you were invited with and we will send a sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Tap it and you are in.
auth.notInvited: This email has not been invited. Ask an admin for an invitation.
auth.fail: Could not send the link. Please try again shortly.
auth.tooSoon: A link was just sent. Try again in a minute.
auth.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new sign-in link.
auth.notMember: You are signed in but not registered as a company member. Please contact an admin.
auth.removed: Your access was removed and you were signed out. Contact an admin if you need it back.
auth.expired: For security, you were signed out {hours} hours after signing in. Please sign in again.
auth.keepSigned: Once signed in, you stay signed in on this device for {hours} hours.
auth.codeHint: If the link opens in a different browser on your phone, enter the 6-digit code from the email here.
auth.codeWrong: That code is wrong or expired. Check the newest email, or get a new link.
auth.about: A ledger where AI reads Thai tax invoices and receipts.

members.title: Members
members.hint: Only invited people can sign in. An invite sends a sign-up email in 4 languages.
members.lastAdmin: There must be at least one admin.
members.namePh: Name shown in records such as deletions
members.sendEmailHint: Email a sign-in link (also resends the invite)
members.rate: Just sent. Try again in a minute.
members.removeDesc: They are signed out right away and can no longer use the ledger, photos or the LINE bot. Their documents and history stay. You can restore access later.
members.self: You can't remove your own access.

export.printHint: In the print dialog, choose 'Save as PDF' as the printer.
export.empty: No documents to export for this month.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.hint: Saving a document registers its seller by tax ID. A corrected name is also used for documents read later.
vendors.empty: No vendors yet. They appear when documents are saved to the ledger.
vendors.deleteDesc: It only leaves the list. This vendor's {count} documents stay in the ledger as they are. If a document from this vendor is saved later, it is added to the list again.
vendors.deleteFail: Couldn't remove it. Only admins can remove vendors.
vendors.pickSearch: Search by name or tax ID
vendors.pickHint: Pick from the list and the name, tax ID, address, phone and last category/payment are filled in at once — no typing in three languages.
vendors.ruleHint: This vendor's documents always get this category and payment. With 'Save without asking' on, a document that passes every automatic check goes straight into the ledger (if any check fails, it waits for a person as usual).
vendors.ruleHintStaff: This vendor's documents always get this category and payment. Only admins can switch on 'Save without asking'.
vendors.ruleSavedAuto: Rule saved. Documents without problems are now saved without asking
vendors.ruleOffer: {name}: the last 3 were all {category} · {payment}. Do it automatically from now on?

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.trendHint: Net total of the documents saved each month
dash.companyMissing: Set our company tax ID to calculate claimable VAT.
dash.profitEmpty: Add this month's sales to see the profit →

line.title: LINE
line.hint: Send receipt photos to the LINE bot and the AI reads them straight into the ledger. The bot replies in Thai and Japanese.
line.codeHint: Add the LINE bot as a friend and send it this code in a 1:1 chat. It works for 10 minutes.
line.step1: Scan the QR code with the LINE app to add the bot as a friend. On a phone, tap the button below instead.
line.step3: Send the code to the bot in the LINE chat and you're connected. The code works for 10 minutes.
line.qrAlt: QR code to add the LINE bot as a friend
line.testHint: Every morning at 9 admins get LINE reminders: bills due within 7 days, and the VAT return 3 days and 1 day before its deadline. Send today's content to your own LINE only as a test (the VAT reminder shows whatever the date).
line.testSent: Test reminder sent to LINE. Check your phone.
line.testFail: Could not send. Please try again later.

report.title: Input Tax Report
report.otherHint: Abbreviated receipts · not addressed to our company · required items missing · claim period passed · forbidden input VAT (entertainment, passenger cars) · copies of invoices
report.note: Prepared from the documents recorded in the ledger. Check against the original documents before filing.
report.companyMissing: Enter our company tax ID in Settings to show the taxpayer details and claimable input tax.

lock.confirmDesc: Locks a month whose tax return is filed. Once closed, its saved documents can't be edited, deleted or added to. Payment and stickers can still change, and an admin can reopen it any time.
lock.fail: Couldn't change it. Only admins can close or reopen a month.
lock.blocked: This month is closed. To edit, an admin has to reopen it in the ledger.
lock.docBanner: This document's month is closed. Its contents can't change; only payment and stickers can. To edit, an admin has to reopen the month in the ledger.

vat.title: VAT return · {month}
vat.todoHint: Sort out the documents to check and the drafts first, so the report is right.
vat.readyHint: Ready. Check the report, file the return, then close the month.
vat.doneHint: This month is closed. Its documents won't change.

bulk.hint: Tick the documents you paid. Only unpaid ones are shown.
bulk.confirmDesc: Amounts to transfer per vendor. Check the payment date.
bulk.fail: Couldn't change them. Check the connection and try again.

tax.claimHint: A late-received invoice can be claimed in the month it arrived. If the invoice month is closed, saving puts it in the next open month. A late claim must be noted on the invoice ('ถือเป็นภาษีซื้อในเดือนภาษี…') and is allowed up to 6 months after the invoice month.
tax.noHint: Entertainment, and passenger cars (≤10 seats: purchase, hire, fuel, repairs) can't be claimed even on a full tax invoice (§82/5). If so, choose 'Don't claim'.
tax.blockedHint: This document's VAT is not claimed ({category}). It goes under 'Other purchases' in the report.
tax.originalFix: Count as an original full tax invoice
tax.originalFixHint: The AI read this paper as a copy or another kind of document, so its VAT is not counted as claimable. Tick to include it as a full tax invoice (ใบกำกับภาษี); the VAT is then included.
tax.whtHint: Choose it when tax is withheld on paying services, rent, etc. It goes on the certificate (50 ทวิ) and the monthly filing list.
tax.movedTo: {month} is closed, so it was saved as a claim in {to}.
tax.whtUnderMin: Withholding usually doesn't apply under 1,000 baht per contract (Order ท.ป.4/2528), unless one contract is paid in parts.

whtList.title: Withholding tax list (ภ.ง.ด.53 · ภ.ง.ด.3)
whtList.note: Only documents marked paid in this month with a withholding (by payment month). Tax IDs starting with 0 are treated as companies (ภ.ง.ด.53), 1–8 as individuals (ภ.ง.ด.3). Condition 1 = withheld at payment. Check against the originals before filing.

whtDoc.title: Withholding tax certificate (50 ทวิ)
whtDoc.banner: This document has a withholding. You can print the certificate (50 ทวิ) for the vendor.
whtDoc.unpaid: Not paid yet, so the payment date is blank.

purge.title: Delete for good?
purge.desc: The {name} document and its photo will be deleted permanently and can't be brought back. Only a record of what was deleted, and by whom, stays. Saved documents of a closed month can't be deleted.
purge.fail: Couldn't delete it. Only admins can delete documents from the trash.
purge.descMany: The {count} chosen documents and their photos will be deleted permanently and can't be brought back. Only a record stays. Saved documents of a closed month are skipped.
purge.lockedSome: {count} documents of a closed month were not deleted.

flow.allDone: All documents to check are done

tr.hint: Type in just one language. When you save, the AI translates each changed field into the other two.
tr.failed: Couldn't translate automatically, so it was saved as typed.
tr.done: The AI translated {count} fields into Thai, English and Japanese

manual.start: Type it in without a photo
manual.title: Document typed by hand

quick.taxSettings: Tax settings (claim month · input VAT · withholding)

cam.title: Quick shoot
cam.hintTwo: Lay one receipt on the left ① and one on the right ②, not overlapping. Each half is read separately.
cam.hintOne: Fill the screen with one receipt.
cam.same: Same picture as the last shot, skipped (no cost)
cam.full: The list is full. Clear read photos to shoot more.
cam.denied: The camera can't be used. Allow camera access in the browser, or use the phone's camera.
cam.hintMany: Lay out up to {max} receipts without overlapping and take one photo. Each is found and read separately. If the text looks too small, take them in parts.
cam.tooMany: Up to {max} receipts per photo. Please take the rest again.
cam.findFail: Couldn't find the receipts. Please try again.

tips.label: What's new
tips.twoBody: In 'Quick shoot' on your phone, lay two documents side by side and take one picture. Each half is read separately, so accuracy stays the same and the cost per document doesn't change.
tips.moreBody: You can now add {max} photos at once instead of 5. The AI reads them {at} at a time.

sales.title: Sales
sales.intro: Record each day's sales from the POS closing report and the delivery apps. Together with purchases it shows the month's result and makes the sales tax report.
sales.vatCredit: More input than output · carried forward or refunded
sales.resultNote: Purchases count by invoice date. Costs not in the ledger (wages, rent…) are not included, so the real profit may differ. Confirm the final figures with your accountant.
sales.empty: No sales this month yet. Upload a POS closing report or type it in.
sales.sheetHint: One line per day and channel. Saving the same day and channel again replaces it.
sales.replaces: This day and channel already has sales. Saving replaces them with these numbers.
sales.vatOff: VAT differs from 7% ({calc}). Check the closing report.
sales.notReport: This doesn't look like a sales closing report
sales.readFail: Couldn't read it. Shoot again or type it in.

pos.title: Import POS Excel
pos.hint: Pick the sales file exported from your POS (.xlsx, .csv). The date, total and VAT columns are found automatically and added up per day and channel. Change any column below if it's wrong.
pos.nothing: Choose the date and total columns. If it's still empty, try another header row.
pos.replacing: {count} lines already there will be replaced by the file's numbers.
pos.vatComputed: The file has no VAT column, so VAT was worked out as 7/107.
pos.xls: Old .xls files can't be opened. Save it as .xlsx in Excel.
pos.readFail: Couldn't open the file. Check it is .xlsx or .csv.
pos.noHeader: Couldn't find the header row automatically. Choose the columns below.
pos.invalid: Skipped {count} lines with a negative total or VAT above the sales. Please check them by hand.

ack.label: Checked by {who}
ack.done: Marked as fine. The 'check' warning is off.
ack.hint: Press when you've checked the document and it's fine. Only the warning goes; whether its VAT can be claimed doesn't change.
ack.open: {count} automatic checks failed. If you've checked and it's fine, press 'Mark as fine'.
ack.marked: Failed automatic checks reviewed by a person · {who} · {when}

fees.title: Delivery app commission (estimate)
fees.note: Commission = orders × GP rate, plus 7% VAT on the commission. Rates differ by app and contract, so this is an estimate — check the app's statement for the exact amount. Record the app's commission tax invoice as a purchase to claim that VAT.
fees.name: Name

pl.title: P&L by category
pl.intro: Sales by channel and costs by category, several months side by side. All amounts exclude VAT (VAT that cannot be claimed counts as a cost).
pl.note: Purchases count by invoice date. Costs not in the ledger (wages, rent paid without a document) are missing. Delivery-app commission is included only when the app's tax invoice is recorded as a purchase. Check final figures with your accountant.

install.title: Install on your phone
install.hint: An icon appears on your home screen and opens like an app, without the address bar. Long-press it to go straight to uploading photos.
install.tip: Install the app on your home screen to open it faster
install.ios1: Tap the Share button <icon></icon> at the bottom of Safari
install.manual: Open the browser menu <icon></icon> and choose 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'.

team.title: Work by member
team.hint: Who uploaded, edited and checked documents this month. Admins only.

push.title: Phone notifications
push.hint: Get reminders on this phone (or PC) without LINE: bills coming due, and the VAT return 3 days and 1 day before its deadline. Every morning at 9, to admins.
push.turnedOn: Notifications turned on for this device.
push.on: Notifications are on for this device.
push.testSent: Test sent. Check your phone in a moment.
push.fail: Could not set up notifications. Please try again later.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this app (or browser) in your phone's settings → Notifications.
push.needsInstall: iPhone shows notifications only in the app added to the home screen. Install it first (above), open it from the home screen icon, and turn them on here.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. Use Chrome, or Safari from the home screen app.

branch.label: Branch
branch.head: Head office
branch.title: Branches
branch.hint: Books, sales, VAT and profit are kept per shop (branch). Give each the buyer branch number printed on tax invoices (สาขาที่) and a photo alone puts the document in the right branch.
branch.hintStaff: Only admins change branches. Pick a branch at the top to see just its books.
branch.deleteAsk: Remove "{name}"? A branch with documents or sales cannot be removed.
branch.inUse: A branch with documents or sales cannot be removed
branch.name: Name
branch.numberHint: Head office is 00000; a branch is the 5-digit number printed on tax invoices (00001, 00002…).
branch.tableHint: Sales excl. VAT, costs, profit and VAT to pay. Tap a branch to see it alone.
branch.sheetHint: Shows only the chosen branch's books, sales, VAT and profit. "All branches" adds them all up.
branch.combinedHint: This month for every branch added up. Tap a branch card below to switch to it.

dep.label: Depreciation period
dep.hint: Equipment is not a cost all at once in the month it is bought: its cost is spread evenly over the period each month (depreciation). Thai practice: computers 3 years, machines, equipment, furniture and vehicles 5, buildings 20. Its VAT is still claimed in the month of purchase.

bulkCat.hint: Tick the documents to re-categorise. Documents of a closed month cannot change. Categories set per line stay as they are.
bulkCat.fail: Could not change them. A closed month's document may be among them, or the connection dropped.

assets.title: Equipment
assets.intro: Equipment whose cost is spread over years: what it cost, what has been written off so far, and what is left (book value). Mark equipment you sold or threw away as disposed: what is left becomes that month's cost and depreciation stops.
assets.empty: No equipment yet. Give a document the category 'Equipment (asset)' and a depreciation period and it shows here.
assets.askHint: Pick the date it went. What is left, {value}, becomes that month's cost. Closed months cannot be picked.
assets.locked: That month is closed. Pick a date in a month that is still open.
assets.note: The cost is spread evenly each month from the invoice month (straight line). VAT is claimed in the month of purchase. Money from selling equipment goes in as sales separately. Check the final treatment with your accountant.

memo.label: Remark
memo.placeholder: Add a note (e.g. checked by the owner, for the March event)

items.title: {count} item lines
items.hint: Write in one language; the others are translated on save. Quantity × price fills the amount. Check the totals and VAT in the fields above.

cats.title: Categories
cats.hint: The categories documents are sorted into. Rename or hide the standard ones, and add the company's own. Write a name in one language and the others are translated.
cats.deleteAsk: Delete "{name}"? A category documents use cannot be deleted (hide it instead).
cats.inUse: Documents or vendor rules use this category, so it cannot be deleted. Hiding it keeps it off new documents only.
cats.hiddenDone: Hidden. Documents already in this category keep it.
cats.name: Name
cats.nameHint: Write it in the screen language and save: the other languages are filled in. Correct any odd translation.
cats.nameHintBuiltin: Leave empty to use the standard name. A new name is used on screens and reports.
cats.translateFail: Could not translate. Please type it.
cats.aiHint: Hint for the AI (what belongs here?)
cats.aiHintPlaceholder: e.g. packing boxes, plastic bags, tape, sticker labels
cats.noVat: Input VAT not claimable for this category
cats.noVatHint: When on, VAT on this category's documents is left out of the claimable amount (e.g. passenger car costs).
cats.noVatFixed: Entertainment VAT is never claimable under Thai law.
cats.foodCostHint: When on, this category's costs count in the food cost ratio.

cost.title: Cost control (food · labour · rent)
cost.hint: Shares of sales without VAT. The vertical line is the target.
cost.noLabor: This month's labour is not in yet
cost.note: Food is the categories with 'Counts as food cost' on (food and supplies to start). Purchases count by invoice date, so stock is not taken into account.
cost.targetsHint: A common restaurant guide is food 30%, labour 30%, rent 10% (70% together).
cost.laborHint: What the company paid for staff this month, the Thai way. No receipts needed. Leave out employees' withholding tax (ภ.ง.ด.1).
cost.wages: Wages (เงินเดือน ค่าจ้าง)
cost.wagesHint: Salaries, day wages and overtime together
cost.social: Social security, employer's share (ประกันสังคม)
cost.socialHint: Only the company's share (the employee's is inside wages)

pay.title: Payroll
pay.intro: Thai payroll: the 1st–15th is paid on the 15th and the rest at month end; social security and withholding tax come out of the month-end payment. Admins only.
pay.noEmployees: No employees yet. Add one below.
pay.employeeInUse: Someone who has been paid can't be deleted. Set a leaving date instead.
pay.name: Full name
pay.privateHint: Personal data for the filings. Only admins see it; lists show the last 4 digits.
pay.extraAllowanceHint: Spouse, children, parents, insurance … Leave 0 if unsure.
pay.whtFixedHint: Leave empty for the app's amount; enter your accountant's if they set one.
pay.noStaffThisMonth: Nobody worked this month. Add employees in the Employees tab first.
pay.whtFixedOn: This employee's withholding is set by hand.
pay.runHint: Saving makes the payslips and filings and puts each branch's labour cost (pay + the company's social security) into cost control. Check the first months with your accountant.
pay.locked: This month is closed and can't be changed.
pay.nothingSaved: No payroll saved for this month. Save it in the Pay run tab first.
pay.pnd1What: Pay the tax taken from salaries to the Revenue Department.
pay.ssoWhat: Pay the employees' and the company's contributions to the Social Security Office.
pay.filingHint: Copy these lists into the Revenue Department's e-Filing and the SSO e-Service. A deadline on a weekend or holiday moves to the next working day. Reminders come 3 days and 1 day before.
pay.ssSettingsHint: The government is raising the ceiling in steps; change it here when it does. Now at most {max} THB a month each side.
pay.ssRangeBad: The floor is above the ceiling.
